fightSong.title: Flow
fightSong.lyrics: Down the river, through the heart / San Antonio playing smart / Current strong, we never stall / Rivers rise and take it all!

stadium.name: The Riverwalk
stadium.tradition: The Barge Parade — mariachi bands float down a canal around the stadium pre-game. If the lead singer hits the high note, automatic win (not really, but we believe).

fanCulture.description: They bring inflatable river tubes to games. After wins they do the 'river walk' conga line. Very fiesta, very football.
fanCulture.tailgate: Tacos, Big Red, and river vibes.

rivalries.name: The Alamo Rematch
rivalries.narrative: They think they're Texas. We *are* Texas.

paAnnouncer.touchdownCall: RIVERS TOUCHDOWN! Flow to the end zone!

cityFlavor: Remember the Alamo, then get tacos. History, culture, and a river that runs through it all.
